newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST - Spain Jan CPI seen up average 0.42 pct m/.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Spain Jan CPI seen up average 0.42 pct m/.

text.p: The following is a simple average of Consumer Price Index (CPI) forecasts contributed by private economists:
Mth Change Range Pvs Yr/yr Range 97/96 Avg
Sources: Intermoney, AFI, Banco Santander, BCH, BBV, BoA, BSN, Merrill Lynch, ICAE, Fedea, Caja Cataluna, Credit Lyonnais, Beta Capital, C. Madrid.
NOTE - The National Statistics Institute will publish the data on February 13. Core inflation excludes energy and fresh food prices.
97/96 is the forecast for December 1997 inflation versus December 1996.
Average is an average estimate of annualised inflation in the 12 months to December 1997.
In December 1996, Spanish inflation was 3.2 percent year-on-year, with core inflation at 3.0 percent.
In January 1996 the CPI was up 0.6 percent monthly and 3.9 percent year-on-year.
